scope: General production principles only. Reference video, transcript, characters, graphics, voice and music are not production assets.

narration.measurement: Local ASR of a partial desktop recording; approximate, not a voice naturalness rating
narration.guidance: Use concrete actions and concise clauses; justify long silent holds with visible progression. Do not force every story to match the same word rate.

performance: emotional poses remain readable on a phone
lighting: colour/contrast escalation tied to story events
